prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE highly polished design-and-motion board for the 8x Social website. TWO references: image 1 is the previous three-video concept to edit and preserve, image 2 is the existing hero showing the five portrait people and the orange circle, to use ONLY in the small scroll sequence.
The user likes the exact layout and fine edges of image 1. Refine those edges into a beautiful, subtle HALFTONE DOT EDGE system shared with the hero. REMOVE ALL visible media controls from the video players: no play, pause, timeline, progress bar, sound, volume, player toolbar, or large overlay icons. Each is simply a clean 9:16 window of original full-colour creator footage. Preserve the three exact clips, their faces, source captions and order from image 1. Three equal players aligned top/bottom and evenly spaced, almost-square tiny-radius corners. Keep one fine understated keyline, and add a thin feathered microdot fringe OUTSIDE the footage, approximately 8-14px wide, dots dense next to edge, delicate and irregular then disappearing into carbon. This is a fine print texture, not a bold dotted rectangle, not glitter, not neon. The same dot size, fringe width and treatment on every video. No blur or dot overlay obscuring faces or cutting the footage. Natural source video colour, not monochrome.
Large main panel occupying upper 72% of the board: exact near-black #111111 continuous page. Header retains serif 8x social, three navigation links, orange Let's talk. Left copy exactly 'Creator content.' / 'Built for the feed.' and 'Creators publish in their own voice.' / 'We run the operation behind it.' Small stacked selectors 'Entertainment', 'Everyday routines', 'Tech in the wild' with restrained orange active dot. Three portrait videos on right, clean footage ending directly above discreet aligned attribution rows. No player controls. Preserve rightmost slim scroll thread from image 1 (THIS page-scroll control remains; media progress controls removed). Portrait hero collage MUST NOT appear in the main video section.
Continuous background: low contrast warm-grey halftone fields flow down PHYSICAL SCREEN EDGES, curve very gently inward behind the media area, merging visually with the three delicate media fringes. A broad quiet dotted texture behind the video group, very subdued, leaving center of page and all text clear. Never a bright wavy ribbon, no solid connecting lines, no enclosing outer box, no horizontal dividing bar, no change in background colour between hero and content. One calm connected carbon canvas. Dots should feel spatial, finely printed and breathable, not decorative clutter.
Lower 28% of board is an off-page motion storyboard on warm stone: FOUR clearly labelled small landscape website frames connected by tiny arrows in storyboard margin only:
'01 / HERO BREATHES' shows reference 2 hero with five faces, existing heading and both edge fields gently expanded.
'02 / SCROLL CONTINUES' shows bottom of the five-person hero moving upward while Creator content and top of the three DIFFERENT videos enter below on exactly the same black surface. Dot fields continue unbroken.
'03 / VIDEOS PLAY' shows the main video section settled with all three different source clips, no player icons, dot fringe around each.
'04 / SOFT LOOP' shows same layout fixed while only dotted texture is slightly broader then fades back. Small zoomed fringe specimen below frames 3 and 4 if space, showing sparse/expanded dots, NOT video motion arrows over footage.
Small captions outside website panels: '8-second gentle breath', 'One continuous surface', 'Muted autoplay in view', 'Edges move. Frames stay still.'
No big page wipe, no transition portal, no new section colours, no moving/tilting/scaling video rectangles, no new headlines, no fake stats. High fidelity exceptional typography and generous spacing. Main final website should look real and implementable. The sequence should make the intended subtle motion understandable. Landscape 1920x1350-like board.
